note: No competitor score is filled in. Every row is UNMEASURED until a run file in eval/results/ with that model's name, the same prompt file, and the same fixed spec exists. A competitor row must never be filled from a vendor blog post, a model card number, or memory. The XIIV row is likewise UNMEASURED in this harness until a run file exists (the separate CPU baseline eval/results/assembled_1b_cpu_eval_2026-10-27.json covers one prompt only and is not a harness run).
segment_definition: 1B segment = publicly released decoder models with roughly 0.5B to 1.7B parameters, runnable on a single consumer GPU. The range is stated explicitly because '1B' in the market covers 1.0B to 1.7B class labels; narrowing it after seeing results would be cherry-picking. XIIV's own size is exact, not a class label: 915,988,480 unique parameters.

xiiv.architecture: Masked discrete-diffusion, bidirectional full attention, context 128
